checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands stay on machine handles.
checks.feet: Left knee and shin rest on an elevated pad; right knee flexes against a plate-loaded roller. Fixed torso, thigh support, heel path and roller contact checked.
checks.movement: Plate-loaded kneeling leg curl: left knee/shin and both elbows supported, right thigh on front pad and knee aligned with side lever pivot. Right leg curls from 180 to 80 degrees against a roller above the ankle. Four seconds curl and four seconds return; switch sides between sets. Generic apparatus, not a dimensional replica.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
